back_left_variant.selector: points of segment 'back' with x_range_px[0] <= x_px <= x_range_px[1] (same as x_range_H on points_H[:, 0])
back_left_variant.x_range_taken_from: target/base_contour_finger_scale.json key pending_stretches (x-range of the finger-scale flag offset_from_visible_edge), extended to the last point of THIS file that carries the flag; every large-form point in this x-range is derived from that constructed stretch, whether it kept the flag or became large_form_bridge
back_left_variant.what: left end of the back below the fork of the back's outline at about (337, 894) px. white_body_outline reading: NO ink line is drawn there, the line is CONSTRUCTED (flag offset_from_visible_edge = visible white-body edge shifted outwards by the measured ink-line width); sky_silhouette reading: the traced top edge of the dark-blue band. The two readings differ by up to 7.1 % of image height on this stretch (judge's measurement, base_contour_params.json back_left_variant). The stretch stays in_S7 = true; tests should report S7 for it SEPARATELY until the user has confirmed the reading (docs/base_contour_report.md section 2 and 12).

order: left frame edge -> crest -> head tip -> inner arc -> trough
contour_definition: LARGE FORM of the great wave: the finger-scale base contour (target/base_contour_finger_scale.json) closed to a region (body inside), morphological OPENING then CLOSING with a disc of radius r = 150 px (exact Euclidean distance transforms at full resolution), boundary re-extracted on the sub-pixel level set and smoothed along arclength with sigma = 0.5 % of image height; the ORIGINAL finger-scale line is kept wherever the regularised line is closer than 0.15 % of image height and the original line itself turns no faster than the ball (9.91 deg per 1 % sample); smoothstep cross-fades of 2 % in between. r follows from spec S8: 15 deg per 1 % of image height = radius of curvature >= 99.1 px.

source_flags.traced: point lies on a TRACED stretch of the finger-scale line; flags are decided on the 1 px polyline BEFORE the final 2 px resampling: distance to the finger-scale line <= label_tol = 0.02 % of image height (0.519 px) in runs of at least 2 %; after the resampling and the rounding to 0.001 px a flagged point of this file may exceed label_tol by a small epsilon (measured in this file over all 914 points that carry an inherited flag: max distance 0.540 px, 2 of them > label_tol)
source_flags.offset_from_visible_edge: point lies on the CONSTRUCTED left end of the back of the finger-scale line (white_body_outline reading: no ink line is drawn there, visible white-body edge shifted outwards by the measured ink-line width; inherited flag, same tolerance rule as 'traced'); in_S7 = true, but the stretch depends on the pending decision 'back_left_variant' (see pending_stretches)
source_flags.large_form_bridge: point moved by the large-form regularisation (in_S7 = true); wins over every inherited flag
source_flags.completed_occluded: hidden behind the near wave, completed (in_S7 = false)
source_flags.completed_other: visible sea patch without a drawn wave face, completed (in_S7 = false)

crest.definition: argmin(y) of a copy smoothed with sigma = 0.5 % of image height (same robust rule as the finger-scale file)

head_tip.definition: right-most point of the large-form head (vertex of a parabola fitted to x(s) within 0.1 % of image height of the maximum)

inner_deepest.definition: argmin(x) of the smoothed copy of the visible inner arc (same rule as the finger-scale file)

trough_level.note: Z = 0 of the frame definition (crest_top_pct + height_pct). NOT measurable in the painting: the trough under the head is hidden by the near wave; the top edge of the visible sea patch right of the near wave was measured at 73.01 % from the top (candidate B estimates the lower end of that patch at about 76.7 %), so 74.7 % lies inside the patch but on no drawn feature

claw_rightmost.how: right-most column with >= 3 ink pixels (R-B < -8) inside the window [2230, 800, 2330, 920]; y = mean row of the ink pixels of that column; x refined to the luma half level between ink and sky along that row

completed_part_px.note: the completed part keeps its flags; its geometry is the finger-scale completion except for the cross-fade next to the junction with the visible inner arc

distance_to_finger_scale_pct_h.note: % of image height; segments of the contour the points belong to; completed_* points excluded; signed: + = the large form lies on the sky side of the finger-scale line (body grown), - = inside the painted body (body cut)

rim_like_thickness_at_tip.definition: diameter of the largest circle tangent to the contour at the head tip from the body side that stays inside the contour (2-D version of the G3 definition in tests/test_mesh.py)

25_pct_H.why_no_width: the back would have to be extrapolated over more than 10 % of image height outside the frame

widths.note: x_front = left-most crossing after the crest (body / cavity boundary, or the top of the head where the level passes above the cavity). The back leaves the frame at about 51 % H: below that its x is a straight extrapolation along the chord of the first 5 % of the back (spec 7b) and the width is NOT a measurement. x_front_shift_px_per_pct_h_of_level tells how ill-conditioned x_front is (a level that grazes a nearly horizontal stretch).
